definitions.short: Shalem , an early name of Jerusalem
definitions.full: H8004. Shalem II. שָׁלֵם proper name, of a location abbreviated from יְרוּשָׁלַםִ (q. v.), and perhaps (Gunk Dr) intended as archaism Gen 14:18 , compare (poetry) Psa 76:3 (|| צִיּוֺן ); see Jos Ant. i. 10 , 2; ᵐ5 Σαλημ and (Psalms) εἰρήνη .
